currencyCheck: Currency check 2026-09-27: the filing this file cites, Seplat_Energy_Plc_2025_AFS.pdf on NGX doclib, could not be read - its text layer is encoded with a custom font mapping and extracts as control bytes (166 of 206 pages yield text, none of it legible), so the currency the filing prints could NOT be confirmed or refuted from it and no value or currency field was changed. Two flags stand: (1) this file declares NGN while the stored magnitudes are mixed - Total assets 9,821,261,000 sits a factor of 1000 below Non-current assets 6,787,040,000,000 in the same file, so at least one of them is at the wrong scale; (2) the NGX-filed Seplat interim on disk (SEPLAT.pdf, half year to 30 June 2026) prints its statements in naira (₦ million), while Seplat annual reports are commonly published in US dollars. Both need a read of the AFS PDF itself, which this pass could not do.
